name: How long does a typical sliding patio door replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding patio door replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation of a single sliding patio door typically takes one to two days, depending on the complexity of the existing opening and any necessary structural adjustments. This estimate includes removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing the new frame and door panels, sealing, and basic trim work. Factors like custom sizing, extensive frame repair, or adverse weather conditions can extend the timeline. Your contractor will provide a more precise schedule after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical replacement takes one to two days, depending on the existing opening's complexity and any structural work needed.
